summary: This excerpt from Book 1 (part 170) follows Marcus and Masha as they change their appearance to evade gait recognition and face databases after a mob incident in San Francisco. Masha warns that both are now wanted criminals and hurries Marcus uphill through the Tenderloin toward a rendezvous. In an alley called Sabin Place, they are cornered by Charles, a classmate in a half-hearted VampMob costume, who has recorded Marcus leading the mob and threatens to call the police.
one_line: Marcus and Masha flee San Francisco after a mob incident, only to be cornered in an alley by Charles, who recorded Marcus leading it.
key_facts: Masha tells Marcus to put pebbles in his shoes and says a sprained foot means no gait recognition program will spot him.
The changeover of their appearance took less than a minute, and they looked and walked like two different people.
Masha says the footage from the mob will be analyzed for days and then every face in it will go into a database.
Masha tells Marcus that they are both wanted criminals and that his choices are her or jail.
Masha gets them off Market Street on the next block, swinging back into the Tenderloin.
Marcus recalls that the Tenderloin is where they hunted for an open WiFi access-point on the day they played Harajuku Fun Madness.
Marcus's foot hurts badly as they climb uphill toward Nob Hill, moving through narrow alleys.
They step into an alley called Sabin Place when someone says, "Freeze right there."
Charles stands at the mouth of the alley wearing a halfhearted VampMob outfit of black t-shirt, jeans and white face-paint.
Charles says he has been hanging out on the Xnet since he saw Marcus giving out DVDs at school.
Charles says he recorded Marcus leading the VampMob and plans to call the cops and wait for them.
Masha had gone still as a board beside Marcus during the confrontation.
